authority: Operational dispatch mirror only; live main/accepted evidence and canonical Drive governance override this file.

defaults.mission: Classifier, Intelligence Router, L0-L5 reasoning, Confidence Engine, strategy registry, agent runtime, bounded inspect/repair loop, routing evals.

tasks.title: W05-00 Coordination / Intelligence Boundaries
actions: 1. Freeze Intelligence vs Authority boundaries and W04/W06/W07 interfaces.
2. Run over-agentification gate before defining workers/agents.
3. Define routing benchmark/eval plan and cost/latency baselines.

tasks.title: W05-A Task Complexity / Risk / Modality Classifier
actions: 1. Classify task class, modality, complexity, reversibility and risk signals needed for routing.
2. Use deterministic rules where possible and explicit confidence/unknown states.
3. Do not turn classifier risk/confidence into permission.

tasks.title: W05-B Intelligence Router
actions: 1. Route among deterministic/no-AI, small/frontier model, specialist, computer-use and human strategies.
2. Use lowest-sufficient reasoning and explicit escalation on uncertainty/risk/conflict.
3. Consume W04 lane/budget/capability context.
4. Emit strategy selection evidence, never executable authority.

tasks.title: W05-C ReasoningLevel L0-L5 Resolver
actions: 1. Define L0-L5 reasoning semantics and selection conditions.
2. Respect latency/cost/reasoning budget.
3. Allow escalation/de-escalation with bounded loops.
4. Reasoning level never elevates permission.

tasks.title: W05-D Confidence Engine + Calibration Interface
actions: 1. Define confidence decomposition/output contracts and uncertainty reasons.
2. Expose calibration interface for W18.
3. Use confidence to request verification/escalation, not authorize.

tasks.title: W05-E Strategy Registry
actions: 1. Define model/specialist/computer-use/human strategy registry and compatibility metadata.
2. Support availability/fallback and model/provider abstraction.
3. Keep strategy registry distinct from W04 Capability Registry.

tasks.title: W05-F Generic Agent Runtime / Worker Pools / Leases
actions: 1. Implement generic worker runtime only where agent semantics are justified.
2. Support leases/heartbeats/reclaim/bounded worker pools and cancellation.
3. Reuse W03 durable primitives where applicable.
4. Prevent hidden agent authority/tool execution.
tasks.forbidden: No god-object orchestrator; no direct side effects.

tasks.title: W05-G Bounded Observe-Plan-Tool-Inspect-Repair-Validate Loop
actions: 1. Implement bounded adaptive loop for tasks that need iterative inspection/repair.
2. Validate tool choices against capabilities and executor boundaries.
3. Set max iterations/time/tool-call budget and loop-break conditions.
4. Persist enough strategy evidence without private chain-of-thought.

tasks.title: W05-H Routing Benchmarks / Evals
actions: 1. Benchmark deterministic, small-model, frontier, specialist and human routes.
2. Compare quality, latency, cost and tool/model calls.
3. Prove quality-compatible routing uses less compute where possible and zero authority elevation.
